featured.label: FEATURED STORY
featured.title: A school kit became a reason to raise her hand.
featured.quote: She held her new bag all morning and refused to put it down. That was the day she started raising her hand.
featured.description: With her own notebooks, pencils, and a quiet place to study, Maya found the confidence to take part in every lesson. Today, she helps younger students prepare their schoolwork.
